publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture Food and Nutrition Administration
ownership: United States federal government public retailer-locator data
source_access: Public anonymous read-only ArcGIS Feature Service; item metadata declares no license or terms-of-use text.
prohibited_use: publishing confidential store-level SNAP redemption amounts
representing SNAP authorization as proof of general operating status
transferring a location-specific authorization assertion to another owner or location
inferring parent company or legal ownership from store name alone
attribution: Source: USDA Food and Nutrition Administration SNAP Retailer Locator.
retention: Indefinite for public source snapshots and derived records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Allowed for the public locator fields with source item, update timestamp, transformation, and semantic limitations retained.
required_application_notice: USDA FNS publishes this public SNAP Retailer Locator layer without item-level license or terms text. SNAP authorization is location- and owner-specific and does not independently establish that a business is currently open, every grocery or retail business, legal ownership, parent company, or transferability to another site. Source fields, points, classifications, and update times remain publisher assertions.
